interface.shortDescription: Record a browser task once and replay it locally with parameters.
interface.longDescription: A local record-and-replay plugin built on OpenAdapt Flow. Start and stop recording from chat, compile the flow, replay it with parameters, query execution results, and generate a Skill and MCP with the official exporter. Requires Python 3.10–3.12, OpenAdapt Flow 2.0.0, and Chromium. The first release supports the browser; a completed replay does not by itself confirm the business result.
defaultPrompt: Record a browser task for me and repeat it with parameters next time.
Export this recorded flow as a Skill and MCP.
